newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil pulled up by futures, firm premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil pulled up by futures, firm premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was hiked higher by stronger futures and steady premiums to a touch firmer premiums, bar barges, traders said.
May IPE gas oil closed $2.00 a tonne higher at $165.50 on the back of a U.S-led rally bolstered by cold weather and some technical buying.
Diesel continued to be sought after with cargo bids of May IPE +$11 cif NWE failing to attract an offer at a close enough number to conclude a deal.
DIN was bid at May IPE +$3.50 cif, with offers $1 or more higher while FOD was pegged around May IPE +$4.
Russian premiums were narrowly stronger with bids heard about 50 cents higher at May IPE +$1.50 with offers still $2 or so away.
Heating oil barge trade was lacklustre with the market ranged between May IPE flat and +$1 for most of the day. A couple of diesel barges were sold at May IPE +$10 and +$10.50 fob AR.
